description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Awoken Water], [Damage Cap +10000], [Tidal Fall] and [Costume Collector Mode]

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Awoken Water
description.text: Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Tidal Fall
description.text: Grants [Attach Water] to the user after using three Water abilities

description.name: Costume Collector Mode
description.text: Grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] and [Instant Cast 1] to the user after using three Water abilities, removed after triggering
